dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a pure-advisor ARKOS persona helper, and the included references, canon hash, and self-check scripts fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to persona behavior, verification, and migration to a successor skill; there are no hidden role overrides, automatic actions, or wrongdoing guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill includes a user-facing npx command to install the successor skill, but it is presented as a migration instruction rather than automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The scripts read only SKILL.md and packaged files under references/ to validate presence and print a hash; no network calls, credential access, broad filesystem reads, or mutation were found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, destructive behavior, or local state writes are present in this skill. The separate verifier mentioned in documentation may write ledgers only if the user chooses to use it.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The file-reading behavior is limited to the skill's own packaged reference files and is disclosed by the verification text and reference list; it does not show arbitrary local file access.
[TP4] expected: The deprecated persona description and the hash/self-check behavior are coherent: SKILL.md explicitly says to show the hash from references/canon.json, and the scripts only validate packaged files or print that hash.
llm.guidance: Safe to install if you want this legacy persona, though new users should consider the named successor skill instead. Only run the external verifier or successor install command if you trust that separate package and want its ledger or migration behavior.
llm.summary: This is a deprecated persona-helper skill whose local reference reads and hash-check scripts are disclosed and limited to its own packaged files.
